post.summary: Sync now
post.description:
Pulls a Google / Outlook / iCloud connection now. A failed sync shows as `status: 'error' | 'reauth_required'`, not an HTTP error. At most once per connection per 30 s (a call in between returns it unchanged). Phone calendars aren't pulled: the app uploads with PUT /calendars/device.

Rate limit: 6 / minute.

post.summary: Upload a photo, GIF or file to send in a message
post.description:
Send its id in `attachmentIds` within a day, or it's deleted. Photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC; up to 15 MB) are turned upright, stripped of metadata and shrunk to at most 2560 px (JPEG, or PNG if transparent); animated GIFs are kept as sent. Files: up to 25 MB, from an allow-list of extensions (docs/API.md, Chat). Wallet passes come back as kind 'pass'. Videos (mp4, m4v, mov): 3 minutes and 100 MB, or with Pro 10 minutes and 300 MB, kept as sent; `poster` becomes `thumbnailUrl`.

Signed in.

Rate limit: 60 / 10 minutes.

bearer.description: Native apps: the token from the `set-auth-token` header of a sign-in.

cookie.name: better-auth.session_token
cookie.description: The web: the Better Auth session cookie (`__Secure-better-auth.session_token` over https).

AccountConflict.description: POST /me/accounts/link, 409: that sign-in already has its own account.

groupColor.description: The group's tile colour token (`t1`–`t5`), behind the item's icon; null without a group.

data.description: Ids to open it with, e.g. `{ proposalId }`.

kind.description: gif = animated (show `url`); pass = an Apple Wallet pass; video plays (older apps show it as a file). More kinds may come: show an unknown kind as a file.

width.description: Pixels, for images and GIFs (null for files).

url.description: Signed link to the file; no auth header needed.

thumbnailUrl.description: A smaller preview for photos (at most 720 px), or a Wallet pass's logo (PNG, at most 480×160); null for GIFs (show `url`, animated) and files.

pass.description: For `kind: 'pass'` (an Apple Wallet .pkpass / .pkpasses): what to show on its card. Null otherwise.

duration.description: For `kind: 'video'`: its length in seconds. `thumbnailUrl` is then its poster (when the app sent one) and `width` / `height` the poster's. Null for everything else.

Attachment.description: A photo, GIF or file in a chat message. URLs are signed and expire after about a week: refetch the message for fresh ones. Sent without a caption, the message's `body` is a summary for older apps ("📷 Photo", "GIF", "📷 3 photos", "📎 Plan.pdf", "📎 2 files", "🎟️ Concert ticket"…).

visibleWeekdays.description: Weekday columns worth drawing (others can never match).

slots.description: Every slot that works, sorted by start.

pendingMemberIds.description: Members who haven't synced yet (ignored when finding times).

checkedUntil.description: Synced members whose calendars are only checked up to `until` (ISO instant), before the end of this range: later days may hide clashes, and they count as free there.

status.description: `hidden` = can't be part of any slot; `match` = a time that works.

busyMemberIds.description: Synced members busy during the relevant window that day.

slotPosition.description: For drawing multi-day slots as one band.

holiday.description: A bank or school holiday's name.

bankHoliday.description: A bank holiday in the group owner's region (`holiday` is then its name); left out otherwise.

preferredBy.description: Members whose preferences this day's time that works fits (only on `match` days).

partial.description: A `match` day whose best time only meets the group's quorum (someone's missing).

series.description: Every occurrence, not just this one

label.description: The calendar's name (calendar busy) or the block's note (manual). Only ever sent to its owner.

title.description: Calendar busy: the event's name, when the calendar gives one. Stored encrypted; only ever sent to its owner.

eventKey.description: Calendar busy: the event's opaque key ('' when the calendar gives no ids).

recurring.description: Calendar busy: the event repeats (so "not busy" can cover every occurrence).

ignoreId.description: Set when you've marked this event not busy: the id to undo it with. It doesn't count as busy.

syncUntil.description: Phone calendars: how far ahead the app should read (ISO instant). Null for server calendars.

url.description: https link (to copy, and for Google Calendar's "From URL").

webcalUrl.description: The same feed as webcal://, which Apple Calendar and Outlook subscribe to.

image.description: The group's photo, shown instead of the monogram tile; null for none.

archived.description: Archived by an admin: listed in the groups list's collapsed Archived section.

text.description: One line, at most 140 characters: the text, a poll's question, the attachment summary when there's no caption ("📷 Photo"), or "📍 Name" / "📍 Location" for a place. Null once deleted.

lastMessage.description: The latest message as a one-line preview (a group update has no author); null before any.

autoArchive.description: Archived automatically once its latest event has passed and nothing else is planned (admins choose).

rhythm.description: How often the group meets ("roughly monthly"), used to suggest the next plan; null for none.

newOwnerId.description: The owner only: an admin of the group who becomes the owner

idToken.description: From Sign in with Apple / Google

merge.description: The sign-in has its own account and the person confirmed merging it into this one

linked.description: Apple / Google sign-ins on this account (email always works too), with the address that sign-in uses when known.

LinkProvider.description: Sign-in providers that can be linked to an account.

merged.description: Another account was merged into this one.

payload.description: The affected resource (Message, Poll, Proposal…): see docs/API.md, Live updates.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last date a repeat can occur; null = forever.

name.description: The name they go by in this group: `nameInGroup` when set, else their account name, or their email address if they've set no name.

nameInGroup.description: The name they chose for this group, or null to use their account name.

synced.description: Has connected a calendar or marked any busy time by hand.

displayName.description: Trimmed, at most 80; null or blank goes back to the account name
Trimmed, at most 80; null or blank goes back to the account name

MemberUpdateBody.description: At least one. `role`: admins only. `displayName`: yours, or as an admin anyone's

MergeCandidate.description: The account a sign-in already belongs to, shown before merging it into yours.

editedAt.description: When the author last edited the text, or null.

deleted.description: Deleted by its author: shown as "This message was deleted" (body is null).

receipt.description: Only on your own messages; `seenBy` in the order they read it.

replyTo.description: A compact preview of the message this one replies to, or null.

attachments.description: Photos, GIFs and files sent with it, in order (empty for most messages, and once deleted).

caption.description: With attachments, `body` is the caption or (with none) a short summary such as "📷 Photo" for older apps; `caption` is just the caption, or null. Null for messages without attachments.

location.description: A place shared in the chat (kind 'text', a one-off pin). `body` is then a fallback for older apps; null otherwise and once deleted.

reactions.description: Emoji reactions, one per person, grouped by emoji in the order each was first used (empty once deleted). Older apps: treat a missing field as [].

name.description: A place's name ("Dishoom Shoreditch"), or null for "my location".

accuracy.description: How precise a device's position was, in metres; null for a searched place.

MessageLocation.description: A place shared in a chat message: where it is and, if it's a named place, what it's called. The message's `body` is a fallback for older apps ("📍 Name", the address, a Google Maps link, one per line). It can't be edited, only deleted.

MessageReaction.description: One emoji on a message and who reacted with it (in the order they did).

MessageReactions.description: A message's reactions after one changed (`PUT`/`DELETE /messages/:id/reaction`, live `message.reactions`).

text.description: One line, at most 140 characters: the text, a poll's question, the attachment summary when there's no caption ("📷 Photo"), or "📍 Name" / "📍 Location" for a place. Null once deleted.

MessageReply.description: The quoted message shown above a reply, as it is now (edits and deletion included).

hasMore.description: More matched than `limit`: search for something more specific.

messages.description: The root (found by following `replyTo` up) and every reply under it, oldest first, deleted ones included; at most 200 (the earliest).

truncated.description: More replies than the server returns (the earliest are kept).

MessageThread.description: A message's thread: the first message of its chain of replies, then every reply under it, oldest first.

end.description: All-day: the exclusive midnight after the last day.

image.description: A cover photo; null for none.

MyPlan.description: A plan from any of your groups, with your reply (null: added straight to the calendar, nobody was asked).

going.description: Upcoming ones you said yes or maybe to, haven't replied to, or that went straight on the calendar (soonest first).

notGoing.description: Upcoming ones you said you can't make.

past.description: The last year, newest first (at most 100).

target.description: The date the rhythm points at (YYYY-MM-DD).

slot.description: The free time nearest it (within a week or so either side), or null if none.

NotificationCategory.description: Kinds of push you can turn off, each covering some notification kinds (NOTIFICATION_CATEGORY_KINDS): chat = message; proposals = proposal.created, proposal.changed; plans = proposal.confirmed, event.created; reminders = reminder; nudges = nudge.

NotificationKind.description: What an Activity item (and its push) is about. `proposal.changed`: a confirmed plan changed (someone can't make it any more, or it was cancelled). `role.changed`: your role in a group changed (`data.role` is the new one). `reminder`: a confirmed plan is tomorrow or in an hour (`data.eventId`), or a proposal you haven't replied to is within a day (`data.proposalId`); `data.reminder` is 'day', 'hour', 'reply' or 'next' ("Same again?"). Show kinds you don't know with a generic icon, and open the group (or proposal) from `data`.

off.description: Categories whose pushes (and emails) are off. Activity still lists everything.

quietHours.description: No pushes between these local times (in your time zone, may wrap midnight), e.g. 22:00–07:00; null for none. With `catchUp`, when they end one push (`kind: 'quiet.summary'`, with `groupId` if it was all one group) says how many updates came in meanwhile that are still unread.

mutes.description: Groups you've muted (active mutes only): no pushes from them until `until` (null = until you unmute).

catchUp.description: One push when quiet hours end, counting what came in. Left out keeps it as it was

redirect.description: Where to land afterwards: a web path, or availabliss://calendars for the apps

proUntil.description: When Pro ends (or renews); null on free or lifetime.

store.description: Where it was bought: app_store, play_store, stripe, rc_billing, promotional.

groupLimit.description: Groups you can own on this plan; null is unlimited.

purchase.description: RevenueCat public SDK keys, null when billing isn't set up (hide purchase UI).

aiPlanner.description: The optional AI planner: `available` = set up on this server; `included` = usable on this plan (Pro).

notes.description: Anything the AI should know (it never sees names or calendars)

PlannerResult.description: POST /groups/:id/planner (Pro): a suggested time, ideas and a plan.

options.description: A date poll's options each carry `slot` (the time it stands for; the label is made in the group's time zone): show who's busy per option with GET /groups/:id/conflicts. Text polls have none.

confirmedBy.description: Confirmed proposals: who confirmed it before everyone had accepted ("Confirm anyway"), null when it confirmed itself because everyone accepted.

needsReview.description: Confirmed proposals: someone who was coming can't make it any more, and the proposer or an admin hasn't yet chosen to keep the plan (`POST /proposals/:id/keep`) or cancel it.

busyMemberIds.description: Open proposals only: members whose calendars or blocks say they're busy at this time.

droppedOut.description: Confirmed proposals: said they can't make it after it was confirmed, not yet reviewed (see `needsReview`).

ids.description: Left out: everything except chats (read by reading the chat)

upTo.description: A message id: it and everything before it

Repeat.description: How a block repeats. `monthly` is the same date each month (skipped in months without it); `monthlyWeekday` the same weekday of the month (e.g. the 2nd Tuesday, or the last one if it started in a month's last seven days); `yearly` the same date each year (29 Feb: leap years only).

window.description: Daily time window, e.g. evenings 18:00–23:59; null = the whole day.

days.description: Allowed weekdays; empty = any. Ignored for `span`.

bankHolidays.description: Include bank holidays (the owner's region): allowed whatever `days` says, and a span stretches over adjacent ones (Good Friday starts a Fri-evening span on Thursday evening; Easter Monday ends a Sun-night span on Monday night).

dates.description: If non-empty, only these date ranges are considered (repeats of an identical range are dropped on save).

timezone.description: IANA zone the times above are in.

quorum.description: "Most of us are free": a time works when at least this many of the required members (synced, not optional) are free. Null or absent: everyone.

optionalMemberIds.description: Members who never stop a time from working (they're shown as missing when busy).

startTime.description: HH:MM, e.g. Fri 18:00 → Sun 23:59 for a weekend.

weeksLater.description: Extra weeks between the start and end day: 0 = same week, 1 = "Tue → following Thu", 3 = "Tue → Thu 3 weeks later", up to 4.

count.description: Slots the timing produces (the "13" in "13 weekends fit this timing").

RequirementPreview.description: POST /requirements/preview: slots the timing produces before anyone's busy time.

weeksLater.description: Extra weeks between the start and end day: 0 = same week, 1 = "Tue → following Thu", up to 4

RequirementTemplate.description: A saved timing to reuse when creating groups.

ResponseKind.description: A reply to a proposal. `maybe` is a soft yes ("I can make it if I must"): counted apart from `accepted`, and it doesn't count towards everyone being in, so a proposal only confirms itself when every reply is a firm yes (the proposer or an admin can still confirm anyway). Treat values you don't know as `pending`.

prompt.description: After each plan, post "Same again?" in the chat with the next free time near the rhythm.

preferredBy.description: Members whose preferences this slot fits.

score.description: Pro: the "best date" score (higher is better), weighing preferences and who's compromised before.

fairFor.description: Pro: people this time suits who've compromised in the group's recent plans.

missingMemberIds.description: Synced members busy at this time, optional members included (with a quorum or optional members); empty when everyone's free. Rank slots with fewer missing first.

SlotNoun.description: What one slot is called: "2 weekends work", "14 dates fit this timing".

end.description: All-day: the exclusive midnight after the last day.

image.description: A cover photo; null for none.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the last date a repeat can occur

weeksLater.description: Extra weeks between the start and end day: 0 = same week, 1 = "Tue → following Thu", up to 4

archived.description: true archives it for everyone, false unarchives

autoArchive.description: Archive it by itself once its latest event has passed and nothing else is planned

rhythm.description: How often it meets (null for none); with `prompt`, "Same again?" after each plan

multi.description: Switching to pick-one keeps each person's first pick

options.description: Text polls only, in order: an `id` keeps that option and its votes, no `id` adds one, one left out goes with its votes

weeksLater.description: Extra weeks between the start and end day: 0 = same week, 1 = "Tue → following Thu", up to 4

username.description: Lowercase, without the "@". Every account gets one when it's made (null only briefly for older accounts).

image.description: A signed /media link (works 7–8 days and stays the same all day, so cache by URL), or a sign-in provider's own picture URL; null for none.

onboarded.description: False until the sign-up wizard is finished.

busyBufferMinutes.description: Minutes counted as busy before and after each busy time when finding free slots and clashes (0 = none). Not applied in GET /me/busy.

eventReminders.description: Pushes before a confirmed plan you're going to: the day before, an hour before, both or none.

showAddToCalendar.description: Shows "Add to calendar" on plans (off for people who subscribe to their plans instead).

autoArchiveNewGroups.description: Groups you create start with auto-archive on (archived once their latest plan has passed). Off by default.

problem.description: Why it can't be used as written, or null.

available.description: Free to take (valid and nobody has it, or it's already yours).

user.description: Who has it, when someone does (you included).

passTypeIdentifier.description: With serialNumber, identifies the pass (e.g. to tell whether it is already in Wallet).

relevantDate.description: When it is for (the event, the flight…), ISO 8601 UTC, or null.

fields.description: Up to four of its fields, most important first.

count.description: How many passes the file holds (a .pkpasses bundle; details are the first one's).

WalletPass.description: Details read from a Wallet pass's pass.json (English text where it is localised): a .pkpass, or a .pkpasses bundle of up to 10 (details are the first one's). The file itself is kept exactly as sent, because it's signed.

value.description: The text, or with `date` an ISO 8601 UTC date-time to show in the reader's own format.
